counterexample_scope: Different rule-set outputs for schema-valid supplied raw values; does not assert that the actual model emits these counterexamples.
enumeration: All three target sentence productions x seven registered numeric boundary representatives x every target-list position, for four representative generated evidence contexts. Does NOT enumerate all identities, values, decoy combinations, source permutations or model executions.
grammar_bound: Templates are finite; the bounded instantiated language is enormous. V4 output value is model supplied and not constrained to the evidence value by its schema. Grammar enumeration alone cannot prove end-to-end equivalence.
proof_obligation_remaining: Formal verification of the model output function, or exhaustive actual model evaluation over all admissible instantiated inputs; neither performed. Supplying a correct raw answer is a conditional test, not such proof.
